subject: tu:game/mb/mb_model
value: VERIFIED RANGE MAP + CORRECTION of the integrator intel behind work_claim.data-asset-split.20260831.v1. Intel said VA 0x80129740-0x80237C5F holds whole asset FILES (objects.ngc, textures.ngc, ANIM.PS2) linked into .data, to be split as binary blobs for a Data% win. TRUST-THE-BYTES verdict: the payload thesis is CONFIRMED but every specific in the intel is WRONG, and the proposed action gains NOTHING. (1) TRUE BOUNDARIES: the unsplit .data gap is 0x80129734-0x80238290 (0x10EB5C = 1,108,828 bytes), not 0x80129740-0x80237C5F. Bounded exactly by game/sys/cardutil.c .data end:0x80129734 (splits.txt L557) and TRK_MINNOW_DOLPHIN/Portable/dispatch.c .data start:0x80238290 (L602). It is DOL section data5 (file 0x00115100, va 0x80118100, size 0x00124940); file offsets 0x126734-0x235290. Zero splits.txt entries overlap it. (2) NO SUCH FILENAMES: byte scan of the full 1.1MB finds ZERO occurrences of 'objects.ngc', 'textures.ngc', 'ANIM.PS2', '.ngc', or any filename-shaped string (0 hits). The only 'PS2'/'static' hits are both inside ONE build-path string at 0x80129740: 'E:/GPS2/Disk/static/'. There are no file magics or container headers. (3) WHAT IT ACTUALLY IS: a PS2-authored LITTLE-ENDIAN static-asset payload embedded verbatim in the big-endian DOL. Decisive test at 0x80129780: words read 7,176,7,134,160,608,17808 as LE and as absurd values (0x07000000, 0xB0000000...) as BE. Content = 0x40-stride record tables plus 0x24-stride upper-case asset-name tables (AAANULLOBJ, COLARC/COLCIR/COLCYL, BUTTON_D/_L/_O/_R/_X, HIFONTS, GREENCIRCTRANS...; 266 name tokens, 0x8012DCD0-0x80237C2C, dominant stride 36). Heterogeneous: 16KiB-block entropy runs H=0.02 (all-zero at 0x801CD734) to H=7.82 (packed at 0x80179734), overall H=5.185 bits/byte -- a composite of sparse tables and packed/compressed sub-blobs, NOT one uniform file. config.yml block_relocations already documents this class in-range: '.data:0x80215358 # compressed payload word, not an extabindex pointer'. (4) THE 34 lbl_ OBJECTS INSIDE ARE DTK ARTIFACTS, not real data objects: dtk's pointer heuristic misreads payload words as VAs and mints a symbol at each target. Proof by construction -- lbl_801D1D1D (address = repeating byte 0x1D) and referenced lbl_802B2B2B (repeating 0x2B); 279 of 277,207 words (0.101%) merely LOOK like VAs; only 33 became symbolic relocations, referencing nonsense like sndVoice+0x3D0 and GetAnimAngXYZVal+0x80C. Independent confirmation: dtk REJECTS a split cut at its own boundary 0x80168417 with 'Invalid alignment for split' -- real C data objects are 4-byte aligned, these are not. (5) CODE REFERENCES: essentially none. Only src/game/mb/mb_model.c (extern u8 lbl_80129740[], 'static fallback model buffer') and src/game/ui/btext.c (extern u8 gDefaultFontData[], 0x80237C60, size 0x630). No .text relocation reaches the interior. Consistent with a blob addressed by base+runtime-computed offset. CONCLUSION: never decompile this range; and see claim.law.splits-without-source-earn-no-matched-data for why blob-splitting it is a measurement no-op.
